mkdir .toolbox
mkdir .toolbox/tasks

cp $PROJECT_ROOT/testdata/scripts/manifests/local-task.yaml .toolbox/tasks/local-task.yaml
cp $PROJECT_ROOT/testdata/scripts/manifests/user-task.yaml home/.config/toolbox/tasks/user-task.yaml

exec $TOOLBOX_BIN __complete run l
stdout 'local-task'
stdout ':4'

exec $TOOLBOX_BIN __complete run u
stdout 'user-task'
stdout ':4'

exec $TOOLBOX_BIN __complete add python --scope p
stdout 'project'
stdout ':4'

exec $TOOLBOX_BIN __complete add python --scope b
stdout 'bundled'
stdout ':4'

exec $TOOLBOX_BIN __complete --log-level d
stdout 'debug'
stdout ':4'
